title: Lighting and Light Steering Feel
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes exterior lighting features and faults with comments about a light steering feel, and many examples are too brief or context-limited to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise tail lights and mirror warning lights as appealing exterior features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe missing or possibly misconfigured handle lights and suspected rear light faults.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention light steering feel, automatic lights at night, and rear light issues without enough context to classify them as clearly positive or negative.

limitations: This topic cluster mixes at least two distinct subjects: vehicle lighting and steering feel.
Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined and are too short or ambiguous to support a firmer sentiment reading.
Only a limited set of fragments was provided, so examples are insufficient to fully characterize all lighting or steering subtopics.
